# `sticky_sessions`

Sticky sessions HTTP filter.

## Configuration Notes

On request: looks up session store for pinned endpoint, sets `ctx.pinned_endpoint_address`. On response: injects session cookie or learns session ID from upstream.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `clusters` | ClusterSessionConfig[] | yes | Per-cluster session persistence configurations. |
| `clusters[].name` | string | yes | Cluster name this config applies to. |
| `clusters[].cookie_name` | string | one of | Cookie name used to store the session ID. |
| `clusters[].cookie_attributes` | CookieAttributes | one of | Cookie attributes for the `Set-Cookie` header. |
| `clusters[].cookie_attributes.domain` | string | no | `Domain` attribute. |
| `clusters[].cookie_attributes.path` | string | no | `Path` attribute. |
| `clusters[].cookie_attributes.http_only` | bool | no | `HttpOnly` flag. |
| `clusters[].cookie_attributes.secure` | bool | no | `Secure` flag. |
| `clusters[].cookie_attributes.same_site` | `Strict` \| `Lax` \| `None` | no | `SameSite` attribute. |
| `clusters[].header_name` | string | one of | Header name to read the session key from. |
| `clusters[].cookie_name` | string | one of | Cookie name to observe in upstream responses. |
| `clusters[].ttl_secs` | integer | no | Idle timeout for session entries in seconds (sliding TTL). The binding expires after this many seconds of inactivity. |
| `clusters[].failover` | bool | no | Re-pin to a healthy endpoint when the pinned one is unhealthy. |
| `clusters[].max_entries` | MaxEntries | no | Maximum number of session entries in the store. |
| `clusters[].eviction` | `lru` \| `ttl` | no | Eviction policy when at capacity. |

## Example

```yaml
filter: sticky_sessions
config:
  clusters:
    - name: app_backend
      type: cookie
      cookie_name: "_praxis_route"
      ttl_secs: 3600
      cookie_attributes:
        path: "/"
        http_only: true
        secure: true
        same_site: Lax
      failover: true
      max_entries: 100000
      eviction: lru
```
